Definition: properly, a fixed weight or measured amount, i.e. (techn.) a maneh or mina
BiblicalUsage: 1) maneh, mina, pound; 1a) 60 shekels and 1/50 talent (of silver); 1a1) 1/60 talent in early Babylonian standard; 1b) 100 shekels and 1/100 talent (of gold)
